citations.claim: Pole exceeds upright limit at first violating step: theta 0.86 rad > 0.8
One step before violation pole approaching limit at 0.71 rad
Three steps before violation pole still within margin but diverging rapidly

counterfactual.change: Set sensor_noise from 0.01524 to 0.0 (single field change); removes measurement noise so controller stabilizes pole, no violation in 43 steps.

explanation: Shrunk scenario has no pushes; failure is driven by sensor_noise=0.015 with dt~0.015. Noisy angle measurement corrupts the state-feedback controller, causing growing oscillations: controller applies large forces (~+40 N) but cart velocity and pole angular rate diverge (v=-8.05 m/s, omega=10.07 rad/s at step 43), driving theta from 0.44 rad at step 40 to 0.86 rad at step 43 exceeding 0.8 limit. Removing noise while keeping all other parameters identical stabilizes the system.
vision_note: From step 40 to 42 the pole leans progressively farther to the right while the cart remains near center. At step 43 the pole tip turns red, indicating the angle has exceeded the upright limit and the pole_upright rule is violated.
